identityDerivative.measurementPreservation: All original numeric JSON tokens retained byte-for-byte. Only identity/dependency strings translated; no geometric re-export or renderer/camera requalification.

qualification: Retained numeric calibration inputs only, not native/GPU qualification, historical state recovery or source acceptance. No source media or screenshots. Analysis source controls are rebuilt with the existing offline source-control builder from pinned tracked originals/subsets; its exposure, FIT station and independent CHECK binding guards remain active.

native.retention: Only matched model identity, complete chosen baseline input, and all435 immutable part paths/rigid world bounds used for component envelopes. Original runtime report is historical and is not required for generation.

candidate.retention: Exact original file bytes, including frozen candidate inputs, source identity and root choices.

request.retention: Only chosen complete input requests and native landmark identity/local coordinates consumed by the Analysis generator and existing source-control builder. All retained values are unchanged; unrelated perturbation controls omitted.

manifest.retention: Only unchanged fullKnownAdditiveCeilingPx, used to reject continuation outside frozen source bounds.

roots.retention: All4080 original group scores retain exact cam roots and frozen chosen root indices. rodRoots is the original allFamilyRoots[1], retaining every numeric field used for source-bound validation and original/continued prediction diagnostics; unused rocker-family costs and other derivation intermediates omitted.

motion.retention: All121 conditional source-native times and complete51 inputs, plus unchanged maximum conditional relative pen residual. No new motion or history inferred.

pinhole.retention: Original finite/positive-depth counts and first frozen fitter camera record only; failed search attempts and raw runtime report omitted.

actualFrozenFitterCameraRecord.intrinsicsEvidence: Square pixels and image-centre principal point; focal fitted only to fitting landmarks.
actualFrozenFitterCameraRecord.projection: pinhole; square pixels; centre or explicitly fixed/fitted principal point; no fitted lens distortion
actualFrozenFitterCameraRecord.coordinateConvention: camera-to-CAD-world; quaternion xyzw; looks along local -Z with local +Y up

centres.retention: Complete original204 FIT centroid frames and complete source measurement authority, unchanged. No source pixels or uncertainty altered.

ledger.retention: Only original independent CHECK source declarations and native identity/local-vertex bindings consumed by the existing source-control builder, plus original counts/source packet hash. CPU projections, residuals and capture intermediates are historical, not source observations.

bankReport.retention: Only original sourceProvenance consumed by the existing source-control builder. Whole-report qualification/status is not a generation input.
